title: dissectors: address a few more warnings

notes.body: @gpotter2 - could you please check the change to packet-etw.c?  I don't know the protocol at all, but it looks as though there are more enum values to add that would require widening the mask to hf_etw_edata_schematl_field_type.

From what I recall, the types that can actually be in the structure are a subset of the list of types that are available. Some types you'll find in the doc are converted at runtime into other types, meaning they cannot appear in the list.

I think the changes are wrong in this regard, I remember testing a bunch of types to make sure that they worked. The 3 first bits have a usage that is not documented :/
Thanks Gabriel, I can remove the change to packet-etw.c (except perhaps the width of the reserved field?).
I think so. The change you did for the reserved field is good, good catch !
